catch_rate.how: share of seeded defects routed to a human (ask/block) instead of AI-cleared

catch_rate_attributable.how: share routed to a human by a specific signal (failing check, verified finding, hard rule, refused clause) that the unmutated original did not raise

caught_by_checks_alone.how: seeded defects where a deterministic check failed (no AI involved; includes mutants without reviews)

missed_defects.how: seeded defects the AI would have cleared

findings_per_reviewer.how: verified vs rejected (unsupported) findings over all replayed changes

human_minutes_full_read.how: reading-speed model in the mandate: lines/min + minutes per file

human_minutes_with_pack.how: pack reading time by tier + per refused item + per verified finding

spotcheck_agreement.how: agreeing spot-checks / all spot-checks in the ledger

seeded_defects_total.how: every evidence/<change>-mutK, with or without reviews

seeded_routed_to_human_before_review.how: facts only (no reviews): mutants at ask/block; attributable = a hard rule fired, or the tier rose, versus the unmutated original routed the same way

reviewer_cross_check.how: blocker/major findings: raised and verified, confirmed by another reviewer (shared anchor), and other reviewers' verified ones this reviewer did not raise

time_per_change.how: reading model; negative = the pack costs more than reading the diff (small changes)

model_tokens_per_change.how: measurement/costs.yaml; estimates where the row says so
